# Product and merch mockups

**Merch with AI: print files that pass POD specs, mockups that match the real product, and honest labels on every image.**

Designs merch and product mockups with AI — tees, hoodies, stickers, posters and mugs for print-on-demand — from a flat transparent print file that passes the provider's specs (Printful and Printify sizes, DPI, no semi-transparency, checked 2026-10) to template, AI and lifestyle mockups, with a tested print-file checker and clear rules on labelling mockups versus real sample photos. Use when an AI character, creator or coin community wants merch, when preparing a print file, when making product mockups for a shop, listing or launch post, or when a print came out with boxes, halos or blur.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 2–3 h per drop, plus sample shipping | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Write the merch brief
2. Generate the flat design, no text
3. Size the print file to the product
4. Run the print-file check
5. Upload, place and order a sample
6. Make the mockups
7. Check every mockup against the product
8. Shoot the sample, then publish

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.
